facts: Parties: Kestrel Software Ltd (Buyer), Corrib Energy plc (Seller); the Company is Holloway Logistics plc.
This Agreement is dated 15 July 2026; Closing is scheduled for 15 October 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 2 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $4,000,000, capped at $5,000,000.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $5,000,000.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 90 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 15 July 2026), either party may terminate.
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 4 years after Closing.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $5,300,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $3,500,000.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $4,380,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $188,760,000.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 27 November 2026.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 18 months after termination of employment.
